title: Verify: No svg remains and obsolete SVG-only tests are replaced
summary: Unit test guarding against svg files and rewrite of tests that asserted svg assets
description: Add a read-only guard walking the two asset roots, and delete or convert tests that asserted SVG files exist.
acceptance_criteria: Guard fails if any .svg is under the asset roots
Old svg tests are removed or converted to PNG assertions
technical_constraints: Unit tests only; read-only directory walk, no writes

steps.action: Walk game/public/assets and game/frontend/public/assets with readdirSync (skip missing dirs) and expect no file ending .svg; also expect manifest.json text not to contain '.svg'.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/noSvgAssets.test.ts

steps.action: Delete game/tests/publicAssetSvgs.test.ts, sg3ObjectAssets.test.ts, sg3CharacterSheets.test.ts, sg3BackgroundFurniture.test.ts, publicAssetUi.test.ts, publicAssetUiManifest.test.ts and game/frontend/tests/scene.test.tsx, since they assert the removed SVG files and SceneView. Edit tests/assetFolders.test.ts to drop the 'every svg starts with <svg' case. Edit frontend/tests/boyManifestFile.test.ts to replace the 'keeps character:boy as SVG' case with an assertion that no character:boy entry exists.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/assetFolders.test.ts tests/noSvgAssets.test.ts tests/manifestLoader.test.ts && cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/boyManifestFile.test.ts tests/bootScene.test.ts
